clip_start.description: Probe clip start, below which objects will not appear in reflections

visibility_bleed_bias.description: Bias for reducing light-bleed on variance shadow maps (Deprecated)

visibility_blur.description: Filter size of the visibility blur (Deprecated)

visibility_collection.description: Restrict objects visible for this probe (Deprecated)

intensity.description: Modify the intensity of the lighting captured by this probe

resolution_x.description: Number of samples along the x axis of the volume

resolution_y.description: Number of samples along the y axis of the volume

resolution_z.description: Number of samples along the z axis of the volume

capture_distance.description: Distance around the probe volume that will be considered during the bake

normal_bias.description: Offset sampling of the irradiance grid in the surface normal direction to reduce light bleeding

view_bias.description: Offset sampling of the irradiance grid in the viewing direction to reduce light bleeding

facing_bias.description: Smoother irradiance interpolation but introduce light bleeding

bake_samples.description: Number of ray directions to evaluate when baking

surface_bias.description: Moves capture points away from surfaces to prevent artifacts

escape_bias.description: Distance to search for valid capture positions to prevent lighting artifacts

surfel_density.description: Number of surfels to spawn in one local unit distance (higher values improve quality)

validity_threshold.description: Ratio of front-facing surface hits under which a grid sample will not be considered for lighting

dilation_threshold.description: Ratio of front-facing surface hits under which a grid sample will reuse neighbors grid sample lighting

dilation_radius.description: Radius in grid sample to search valid grid samples to copy into invalid grid samples

capture_world.description: Bake incoming light from the world instead of just the visibility for more accurate lighting, but lose correct blending to surrounding irradiance volumes

capture_indirect.description: Bake light bounces from light sources for more accurate lighting

capture_emission.description: Bake emissive surfaces for more accurate lighting

clamp_direct.description: Clamp the direct lighting intensity to reduce noise (0 to disable)

clamp_indirect.description: Clamp the indirect lighting intensity to reduce noise (0 to disable)
